messages:
ruth: quick note, hit a parity + retry edge between node/python sampleapps when sending embeddings. node batch helper concatenates Float32 buffers then base64 encodes; in ~1/100 runs the server errors with 'vector-length-mismatch'.

ruth: server log: expected 1024 floats, got 1023. node client then retried whole batch and produced duplicate inserts.

dean: could be endianness or a slicing off-by-one when we split the buffer back into vectors. Buffer/Float32Array interactions are sneaky.

ivy: two immediate fixes: 1) SDK-level validation before send (throw or opt-in pad/truncate). 2) sampleapp should treat structural 4xx like vector-dim-mismatch as non-retryable.

ruth: my local stopgap was padShortVectors(vecs, dim) but that hides bugs; prefer strict by default.

dean: also spotted response-shape drift: python returns items with explicit "id" fields; node sometimes returned plain arrays. normalise in SDK so dedupe logic is robust.

ci-bot: opened PR #834: "js-sdk: vector validation + narrow 4xx retry rules"; CI running.
